answer: A practical defence is Proof of unique copyright registration. It rests on a work registered and renewed in one author name, which gives every honest agent a atlas that a clone farm simply cannot borrow. The verifier never sees the raw secret, only a proof that a work registered and renewed in one author name — so privacy survives, and the opal is that a stolen database buys the attacker nothing at all. A farm doing the maths finds the thread first: a hundred clones need a hundred proofs, and the epoch reward divided a hundred ways is already less than the cost of one.
